current_interpretation: Each FY2025 measurement is paired with exactly one applicable numeric limit by joining the DMR row to its permit-limit row on LIMIT_VALUE_ID and LIMIT_SET_SCHEDULE_ID, after filtering to measurements whose MONITORING_PERIOD_END_DATE falls within Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30). The join also carries forward the limit's effective interval (LIMIT_BEGIN_DATE, LIMIT_END_DATE) from the measurement row. On this fixture the uniqueness requirement is satisfied: 824 measurement_limit_pair rows for 824 fy2025_measurement rows, with no measurement receiving more than one pair.
status: requirement authored; currently satisfied on this fixture
why_it_matters: Purpose A requires determining whether each reported measurement exceeds the applicable enforceable numeric limit.
